title: Heap path index
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a Boolean string indexed by $0,\ldots,n-1$, and let $o$ be a natural number. Define $h(0)=1$ and, for every natural number $\ell$, define $h(\ell+1)=2h(\ell)+b_{o+\ell}$, where $b_j=x_j$ if $j<n$ and $b_j=0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean string indexed by the first $n$ natural numbers
